title: 第11章 帝子大婚各方反应第12章 一年一个
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 与暗流涌动的太古神山不同，此刻的江家则是一片欢腾。
当江战和江守拙乘坐着黄金神舟，在一阵阵大道伦音中返回家族领地时，早已等候多时的族老们立刻迎了上来。
“家主，三长老，回来了！”
“怎么样怎么样？事情办妥了吗？”
“那白虎王族有没有不识抬举？”
族老们一个个围了上来，七嘴八舌，脸上写满了急切。
“哈哈哈，都别急，都别急！”
三长老江守拙人还没落地，爽朗的大笑声就已经传遍了整个帝宫。
他从神舟上一跃而下，红光满面，那股子兴奋劲，简直比他自己娶老婆还高兴。
“妥了！太妥了！”江守拙一拍大腿，“你们是没看到啊，当家主把聘礼拿出来的时候，太古神山那帮老家伙，眼珠子都快瞪出来了！”
“尤其是凤凰一族那个老鸟，脸都绿了！还有他们那个什么神女，叫凤灵儿的，之前还敢瞧不起我们渊儿，说什么废物不配娶她，结果呢？我们压根就不是去找她的！哈哈哈，那场面，太解气了！”
江守拙绘声绘色地将太古神山发生的事情讲了一遍，尤其是凤灵儿自作多情，被江战当众打脸的那一段，更是说得手舞足蹈，唾沫横飞。
听得在场的族老们一个个眉开眼笑，抚掌大快。
“好！干得漂亮！”
“就该这样！让他们知道，我们江家的帝子，也是他们能随便非议的？”
“那帮鸟人，仗着自己血脉特殊，向来眼高于顶，这次总算让他们吃瘪了！”
“活该！谁让她有眼无珠，错过了我们渊儿这么好的麒麟儿！”
族老们议论纷纷，言语间充满了对江家的自豪和对凤凰一族的鄙夷。
江战从神舟上缓缓走下，脸上也带着一丝笑意，他摆了摆手，示意众人安静。
“事情已经办妥，白虎王族已经答应了婚事。三日后，便是渊儿迎亲之日。”
“太好了！”
“我江家的麒麟儿，终于要成家了！”
“快快快，大婚筹备组的人呢？赶紧把排场给我搞起来！必须是最高规格！要让整个帝仙大世界都知道，我们江家对这门亲事的重视！”
整个江家都沉浸在喜悦的氛围中。
而作为事件的主角，江渊此时正优哉游哉地躺在自己的寝宫里，听着侍女小翠的汇报。
“……三长老说，那个凤凰神女的脸都气白了，当场就跑了。家主还说，她配不上少主您呢！”
小翠一边给江渊捏着腿，一边叽叽喳喳地说道，脸上满是崇拜和与有荣焉。
“哦？我大伯真这么说？”江渊挑了挑眉，心里一阵舒坦。
妈的，这才叫帝子该有的待遇啊！
人在家中躺，锅从天上来，哦不，是逼从天上来。
自己啥也没干就莫名其妙地成了别人眼中的香饽饽，还有一个不知所谓的天之骄女因为看不起自己而被当众打脸，成了天下笑柄。
这种感觉，怎么说呢？
爽！
太爽了！
“不愧是我大伯，装起逼来一套一套的，有我爹当年的风范。”江渊心里美滋滋地想着。
他唤出系统面板，目光落在了白清雪的资料上。
【姓名：白清雪】
【身份：太古神山白虎神女（江家帝子未婚妻）】
content_en:
Different from the ancient sacred mountain where the undercurrent is surging, the Jiang family is full of joy at this moment.
When Jiang Zhan and Jiang Shouzhuo returned to their family territory in the golden divine boat amidst bursts of Dao Lun sounds, the clan elders who had been waiting for a long time immediately came to greet them.
"The head of the family, the third elder, is back!"
"How's it going? Is the matter done?"
"Then the White Tiger Royal Family doesn't know how to appreciate others?"
The clan elders gathered around one by one, talking all over the place, with eagerness written on their faces.
"Hahaha, don't be impatient, don't be impatient!"
Before Third Chang Jiang Shou Zhuo landed, the hearty laughter spread throughout the imperial palace.
He jumped off the Shenzhou, his face glowing red, and he was so excited that he was even happier than he was to marry his wife.
"It's done! It's so done!" Jiang Shouzhuo slapped his thigh, "Didn't you see that when the head of the family took out the betrothal gift, the eyes of those old guys from Taikoo Sacred Mountain almost popped out of their heads!"
"Especially that old bird from the Phoenix clan, his face turned green! And that goddess of theirs, Feng Ling'er, who dared to look down on our Yuan'er before, saying she was a loser and not worthy of marrying her, but what happened? We didn't go looking for her at all! Hahaha, that scene was so satisfying!"
Jiang Shouzhuo vividly recounted what happened in the Taikoo Sacred Mountain, especially the part where Feng Ling'er was slapped in the face by Jiang Zhan for being sentimental. She was dancing and spitting.
Hearing this, the clan elders present all smiled happily and clapped their hands happily.
"Okay! Well done!"
"That's it! Let them know that we, the emperor of the Jiang family, are the ones they can criticize at will?"
"Those birdmen, relying on their special bloodline, have always had their eyes set on the top, but this time they were finally defeated!"
"She deserves it! Who made her so blind that she missed such a good Qilin'er like our Yuan'er!"
The clan elders were talking a lot, their words filled with pride for the Jiang family and contempt for the Phoenix clan.
Jiang Zhan slowly walked off the Shenzhou with a smile on his face. He waved his hand to signal everyone to be quiet.
"The matter has been settled. The White Tiger Royal Family has agreed to the marriage. In three days, it will be the day when Yuan'er welcomes the bride."
"Great!"
"My Qilin'er from the Jiang family is finally getting married!"
"Quick, quick, quick, where are the people from the wedding preparation team? Hurry up and arrange the ceremony for me! It must be of the highest standard! Let the entire world of Emperor Immortal know that our Jiang family attaches great importance to this marriage!"
The entire Jiang family was immersed in an atmosphere of joy.
As the protagonist of the incident, Jiang Yuan was lying leisurely in his bedroom, listening to the report of the maid Xiaocui.
"...The third elder said that the Phoenix Goddess's face turned pale with anger and ran away on the spot. The head of the family also said that she was not worthy of you, young master!"
Xiao Cui was squeezing Jiang Yuan's legs and chirping, her face full of admiration and pride.
"Oh? My uncle really said that?" Jiang Yuan raised his eyebrows, feeling relieved.
Damn it, this is how an emperor's son should be treated!
When a person is lying at home, a pot comes from the sky, oh no, a pot comes from the sky.
She had somehow become a favorite in the eyes of others without doing anything. There was also a so-called proud girl who was slapped in the face because she looked down on her and became the laughing stock of the world.
How do you describe this feeling?
Cool!
So cool!
"As expected of my uncle, he puts on all kinds of tricks, just like my father did back then." Jiang Yuan thought happily.
He called up the system panel and his eyes fell on Bai Qingxue's information.
[Name: Bai Qingxue]
